rationale: FAST gapped down ~7.6% at the open and has since recovered nearly the entire gap, now sitting at 99.6% of today's range and within 0.03% of the session high — an extreme position that offers poor risk/reward in either direction. Chasing a long at the high after a massive intraday reversal risks a mean-reversion pullback, while shorting into strong upward momentum with price above VWAP and 9-EMA is equally dangerous. With today's realized P&L already negative and loss budget limited, the asymmetry does not justify a new position.
